visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses wearing a black button-down shirt stands in a dimly lit studio environment with bookshelves and a plant in the background. He holds a clear glass beaker containing a transparent liquid, gesturing with his left hand while speaking directly to the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a series of fast-paced clips: a famous actor giving a thumbs-up in a vintage film, a close-up of a microchip on a circuit board, and an animation of a factory assembly line with mechanical arms moving chips. (3) An animation shows colorful characters covered in black sludge, followed by a return to the presenter who gestures broadly. (4) A dachshund wearing goggles and a lab coat is shown in a kitchen setting, pouring liquid from a beaker into a funnel, creating a burst of white steam. (5) A meme of a cat with its arms wide open is followed by a clip of a man in a car opening a plastic bottle that explodes with carbonated liquid, soaking him. (6) The presenter points down at a large industrial machine consisting of stainless steel pipes and a large cylindrical tank labeled as a 'Rotating Packed Bed'. (7) A cat is seen spinning on a vinyl record player, followed by a seal spinning on ice and a raccoon looking through a fence with the caption 'I WILL CATCH YOU'. (8) Clips from 'South Park' and 'SpongeBob SquarePants' are interjected, showing characters reacting to water and flexing muscles. (9) A clip of a handshake from an anime occurs before returning to the presenter, who is still holding the beaker and looking inquisitively at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast pace. An upbeat, bass-heavy trap beat starts immediately. A 'pop' SFX punctuates the opening statement. (2) As the speaker discusses semi-conductors, a digital 'ding' and a 'whoosh' transition sound occur. The BGM remains consistent with a heavy kick drum and synth melody. (3) A sudden 'splash' and liquid explosion sound effect coincide with the visual of a soda bottle opening. The speaker's tone remains authoritative yet conversational. (4) A mechanical whirring sound effect is added when the industrial machinery is mentioned, blended with a 'sparkle' chime. (5) A series of rapid cartoon 'boing' and 'slide' sound effects accompany the animal meme sequence. (6) A sharp 'ding' sound effects occurs during the mention of 80% efficiency. (7) The video concludes with the speaker asking a final question, the BGM swells slightly then cuts sharply at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Context -> Problem -> Solution/Mechanism -> Efficiency Stats -> Future Outlook -> CTA/Engagement Hook.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about TSMC's innovative carbon capture technology using a 'Rotating Packed Bed' system, contrasting it with traditional, bulky chemical absorption methods. It uses a high-energy, meme-heavy format to make complex industrial ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) topics accessible and engaging for a younger or general audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly mentions 'TSMC' (台積電) and their specific technology/ESG efforts, and features the 'Sci-Tech Vista' logo as an advertisement.
